wizard.branding.title: Appearance & colors
wizard.trial.title: Trial

recovery.warning: This key is shown only once. Print it or write it down and keep it somewhere safe. Without it, the owner password cannot be recovered and the data cannot be moved to a new computer.
recovery.confirm: I have printed or written down the key and stored it safely

error.not_set_up: The clinic is not set up yet.
error.already_set_up: This computer is already set up.
error.session_expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.account_locked: Too many failed attempts: the account is locked for 15 minutes.
error.recovery_key_invalid: The Recovery Key is not correct.
error.validation: Some information is missing or invalid; check the fields marked in red.
error.conflict: Another user changed this record. Refresh and try again.
error.internal: Internal error. Details were written to the log file.
hint.username: English letters, digits and . _ - only; 3–32 characters. Example: dr.ahmad
hint.password: At least 8 characters. Mixing letters and digits is safer.
hint.displayName: The name shown in the app and reports, e.g. “Dr. Ahmad”.
hint.role: The role decides which parts of the app this user can open.
hint.clinicName: The name on your clinic's sign and receipts.
hint.calendar: Dates across the app are shown in this calendar.
hint.theme: The clinic default; each user can change it from their menu.
hint.colors: Buttons and selected items use the clinic's main colour.
hint.timeout: Between 1 and 240 minutes. The screen locks when nobody uses the app.
hint.backupHour: The daily backup runs from this time on (while the app is open).
hint.keep: Between 1 and 365. Older backups are removed automatically.
rule.username_latin: Use English letters, digits and . _ - only; Dari/Pashto letters are not allowed.
rule.username_chars: No spaces or symbols; only English letters, digits and . _ -
rule.username_length: The username must be 3–32 characters long.
rule.username_format: Username: English letters, digits and . _ - only; 3–32 characters.
rule.username_taken: This username is already taken; choose another.
rule.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters.
rule.display_name_length: The display name must be 1–100 characters.
rule.clinic_name_length: The clinic name must be 1–120 characters.
rule.role_not_assignable: This role cannot be given to this user.
rule.owner_immutable: The owner's role and status cannot be changed.
rule.working_hours: On every open day, closing time must be after opening time.
rule.backup_hour_range: The backup time is not valid.
rule.logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPG or WebP file.
rule.logo_size: The logo can be at most 2 MB.
rule.recovery_key: This recovery key does not match this clinic. Check the letters again.
rule.invalid_params: The entered information is incomplete or invalid.
rule.phone: The phone number must have 7–15 digits.

recover.subtitle: Use the recovery key you printed at setup to set a new password.
recover.keyHint: 36 letters in 6 groups; upper or lower case does not matter.
shell.commandPalette.title: Quick search

system.detailsHint: For technical support; not needed for daily work.

users.addHint: The user signs in with this username and password.
users.ownerFixed: The clinic owner is always active and keeps the owner role; only the display name can change.
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action, with time, user and computer.
audit.readOnly: This log is read-only: nobody, not even the owner, can change or delete it.
settings.subtitle: Auto-lock and daily backups for every computer of this clinic.
settings.securityHint: Keeps patient data hidden when nobody is at the desk.
settings.backupHint: When the daily backup runs and how many are kept.

clinic.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB; a square image works best.
clinic.locationHint: Printed on the clinic's receipts and documents.
clinic.practiceHint: How dates are shown, and simpler forms for one-doctor clinics.
clinic.appearanceHint: Colour changes preview instantly; Save keeps them.

wizard.welcome.p2Hint: Daily work never stops when the internet is down.
wizard.welcome.p3Hint: Everyone works in their own language.
wizard.language.hint: The app's default language; each user can switch later.

wizard.clinicInfo.hint: This appears on your receipts and printed documents.
wizard.clinicInfo.logoNone: No logo yet; the clinic name's first letter is shown.
wizard.hours.hint: The calendar for dates, and when the clinic is open.
wizard.clinicType.hint: In a one-doctor clinic, forms pick the doctor automatically.
wizard.branding.hint: Light or dark, and your clinic's colours; changes preview instantly.
wizard.backup.encryptedHint: Every backup is encrypted and verified.
wizard.owner.hint: The owner can do everything, and only the owner can recover access with the recovery key.
